mission: Design the first executable repository Context Fabric prototype: artifact inventory schema, metadata extraction, folder/domain digest generation, typed graph edges, incremental hash invalidation and context receipt output. Reuse current GitHub repository structure and current durable schemas. Produce exact files/scripts/tables to build first, with a smallest end-to-end canary that proves a planner can find critical context without scanning the repo.
acceptance_criteria: concrete schema/files/scripts or tables are named
smallest runnable canary and falsifiers are explicit

context_receipt.mission: Produce an executable first Context Fabric prototype blueprint and falsifiable canary without mutating shared authority/architecture heads.
contradictions_surfaced: Compiled packet main head predates concurrent canary claim/run commits; authoritative task selection is therefore refreshed from live queues/claims, while shared authority heads remain untouched.
context_receipt.token_file_budget_estimate: Open only opportunity read_scope plus a focused sample of current durable schemas; avoid repository-wide scan.

C2 inspect representative durable schemas and repository layout
C3 define executable inventory/digest/graph/receipt schemas and incremental invalidation algorithm
C4 define smallest end-to-end planner retrieval canary and falsifiers
